lines.zh: 我每一步都踩得地面发闷。
lines.en: Every step of mine makes the ground hum dully.

lines.zh: 墙缝里的灰随我走过掉落。
lines.en: Dust falls from the cracks as I pass.

lines.zh: 敲门声响完了，我该来了。
lines.en: The knocking is done. I should arrive.

lines.zh: 我的脚步比你先到这里。
lines.en: My footsteps arrive before I do.

lines.zh: 走廊太长，可我从不迷路。
lines.en: The corridor is long, yet I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我拖着影子一起往前。
lines.en: I drag my shadow along with me.

lines.zh: 门框在我肩边响了一声。
lines.en: The doorframe creaks beside my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，也从不慢下来。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, and I never slow.

lines.zh: 墙上的光被我一点点吃掉。
lines.en: I eat the light on the walls, a little at a time.

lines.zh: 拐角之后还是拐角。
lines.en: Past this corner is another corner.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过整个房间。
lines.en: One stride of mine crosses the whole room.

lines.zh: 我跟在你留下的痕迹上。
lines.en: I am following the traces you left.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一堵没有门的墙。
lines.en: I stand like a wall with no door.

lines.zh: 低音在我胸腔里震。
lines.en: A low tone rumbles in my chest.

lines.zh: 我在墙里等，数着你的敲门声。
lines.en: I wait inside the wall, counting your knocks.

lines.zh: 空气在我周围变重了。
lines.en: The air grows heavy about me.

lines.zh: 我的影子比我的身体更黑。
lines.en: My shadow is blacker than my body.

lines.zh: 我等得比你想象的久。
lines.en: I wait longer than you imagine.

lines.zh: 屋里的钟停了。
lines.en: The clock in the room has stopped.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸声像远处的地鸣。
lines.en: My breathing sounds like distant ground-shaking.

lines.zh: 墙角的阴影朝我这边转。
lines.en: The shadow in the corner turns toward me.

lines.zh: 我不动，环境却在动。
lines.en: I stay still while everything else moves.

lines.zh: 地板下的木头一直响。
lines.en: The wood under the floor keeps creaking.

lines.zh: 我又数了一遍房间。
lines.en: I have counted the rooms again.

lines.zh: 这里比上次更暗。
lines.en: It is darker here than last time.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，天花板低得可笑。
lines.en: I raise my head; the ceiling is absurdly low.

lines.zh: 你听见那三下敲门声了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear those three knocks?

lines.zh: 低音结束的时候，我就到了。
lines.en: When the low tone ends, I am already here.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，我早就量好了。
lines.en: I measured where you would stand long ago.

lines.zh: 别往后退，身后也是墙。
lines.en: Do not step back; there is wall behind you too.

lines.zh: 我一直在最近的地方出现。
lines.en: I always appear at the nearest point.

lines.zh: 你数过这间屋子的角吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the corners of this room?

lines.zh: 你听见的敲门声，只响在我这里。
lines.en: The knocking you hear only sounds where I am.

lines.zh: 我们离得很近了。
lines.en: We are very close now.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯不亮了。
lines.en: The lamp in your hand has gone out.

lines.zh: 我以为你会跑得更快。
lines.en: I expected you to run faster.

lines.zh: 你不用回头，我已经在看了。
lines.en: No need to look back; I am already looking.

lines.zh: 你身上有走廊的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of corridors.

lines.zh: 你以为那是风，其实是我。
lines.en: You thought that was wind. It was me.

lines.zh: 先敲门，再出现，这样才够。
lines.en: First the knock, then I appear.

lines.zh: 你的身后一直有个位置是我的。
lines.en: There has always been a place behind you that is mine.

lines.zh: 第一次敲门是提醒，第二次不是。
lines.en: The first knock was a warning. The second was not.

lines.zh: 我看着你，你也感觉到了。
lines.en: I am watching you, and you can feel it.

lines.zh: 这间屋子没有别的出口。
lines.en: This room has no other exit.

lines.zh: 你的影子刚才自己动了一下。
lines.en: Your shadow moved by itself just now.

lines.zh: 我们该换个地方了。
lines.en: It is time we went somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我散成一团嗡鸣，又聚回来。
lines.en: I scatter into a drone and gather again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我慢了一点。
lines.en: That slowed me a little.

lines.zh: 墙上的裂缝合起来了。
lines.en: The crack in the wall has closed.

lines.zh: 我的形状散了又聚。
lines.en: My shape scatters and gathers again.

lines.zh: 低音断了一瞬。
lines.en: The low tone broke for an instant.

lines.zh: 我退进了墙里。
lines.en: I withdrew into the wall.

lines.zh: 房间暗了一档。
lines.en: The room went one shade darker.

lines.zh: 你的武器沾上了灰。
lines.en: Your weapon is covered in dust.

lines.zh: 这一击只让低音短了一拍。
lines.en: That strike only shortens the bass by one beat.

lines.zh: 你以为伤到我了。
lines.en: You believe you hurt me.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我看得见。
lines.en: You hold it up. I can see it.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只收下。
lines.en: I do not eat. I only take.

lines.zh: 食物留在地上，会烂。
lines.en: Food on the floor will rot.

lines.zh: 你要用它换什么？
lines.en: What are you hoping to trade it for?

lines.zh: 那点味道，遮不住你的。
lines.en: That smell does not hide yours.

lines.zh: 你伸手的时候，我往前一步。
lines.en: While your hand reaches out, I take one step in.

lines.zh: 你端了这么久，手会酸的。
lines.en: You have held it so long; your arm will tire.

lines.zh: 放桌上，退开三步。
lines.en: Set it on the table and take three steps back.

lines.zh: 我看着那东西，也看着你。
lines.en: I watch the thing, and I watch you.

lines.zh: 不够，远远不够。
lines.en: Not enough. Nowhere near.

lines.zh: 你撞到的不是实体。
lines.en: What you struck was not solid.

lines.zh: 我的手已经搭上你的肩。
lines.en: My hand has already settled on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一碰之后，地方会变。
lines.en: After this touch, the place will change.

lines.zh: 你想推开我，推不动。
lines.en: You try to push me away. You cannot.

lines.zh: 走廊在这里折了一下。
lines.en: The corridor folds here.

lines.zh: 我们之间的空气黏住了。
lines.en: The air between us has gone sticky.

lines.zh: 你退开后，墙长出来了。
lines.en: You stepped back, and a wall grew.

lines.zh: 这一刻被拉得很长。
lines.en: This moment is being stretched very long.

lines.zh: 地板开始往下沉。
lines.en: The floor is beginning to sink.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的瞬间，地面换了纹理。
lines.en: The instant you hit me, the floor changes texture.

lines.zh: 你在这儿待得越久，越像我。
lines.en: The longer you stay, the more you resemble me.

lines.zh: 我不需要同伴，只需要你留下。
lines.en: I need no company. I only need you to stay.

lines.zh: 我们把门关上，慢慢谈。
lines.en: Let us shut the door and talk slowly.

lines.zh: 你走一步，屋子就窄一寸。
lines.en: Each step you take narrows the room an inch.

lines.zh: 我们之间有根线，你看不见。
lines.en: There is a line between us you cannot see.

lines.zh: 你在这待久了，轮廓会跟我一样。
lines.en: Stay long enough and your outline will match mine.

lines.zh: 你可以坐着，我不介意。
lines.en: You may sit. I do not mind.

lines.zh: 安静一点，这样更好。
lines.en: Be quieter. That is better.

lines.zh: 我们还可以再待一会儿。
lines.en: We can stay a while longer.

lines.zh: 别急着走，门还没开。
lines.en: Do not hurry off; the door is not open.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，灰就落了。
lines.en: I pick it up and dust falls away.

lines.zh: 这东西原本不是你的。
lines.en: This was never yours to begin with.

lines.zh: 你掉的钥匙，砖缝里已经没有了。
lines.en: The key you dropped is gone from the brick crack.

lines.zh: 你掉了，就别想要回去。
lines.en: You dropped it; do not expect it back.

lines.zh: 我把你的东西翻过来，看了看底面。
lines.en: I turn your thing over and look at its underside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢拿起来，看着你。
lines.en: I lift it slowly, watching you.

lines.zh: 这重量，我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted its weight.

lines.zh: 我把东西摆回原来的位置。
lines.en: I set it back exactly where it was.

lines.zh: 少了一件，你数得出来吗？
lines.en: One thing fewer — would you notice?

lines.zh: 地上总会有东西留下。
lines.en: Something is always left on the floor.

lines.zh: 我选中的就是你。
lines.en: You are the one I have chosen.

lines.zh: 你已经听不见敲门声了。
lines.en: You can no longer hear the knocking.

lines.zh: 低音起来的时候，跑没有用。
lines.en: When the low tone starts, running is useless.

lines.zh: 我离你只剩一堵墙。
lines.en: Only one wall separates us now.

lines.zh: 你在移动，我知道方向。
lines.en: You are moving. I know the direction.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子归我。
lines.en: This room belongs to me.

lines.zh: 低音停下时，我就在最近的角落。
lines.en: When the bass stops, I am in the nearest corner.

lines.zh: 我要的不是命，是你。
lines.en: It is not your life I want. It is you.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经到你脚下了。
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 你听到的那声是我开始的信号。
lines.en: That sound you heard was my beginning.

lines.zh: 墙缝在收紧。
lines.en: The cracks in the wall are closing.

lines.zh: 现在开始，别回头。
lines.en: From now on, do not look back.

lines.zh: 你走的那条路我封了。
lines.en: I have sealed the path you took.

lines.zh: 你的位置比我想的更好找。
lines.en: Your position was easier to find than I thought.

lines.zh: 我来了，就在最近处。
lines.en: I am here — at the nearest point.

lines.zh: 这次不会再让你走掉。
lines.en: This time I will not let you leave.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在你身后停住。
lines.en: My footsteps stop behind you.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一寸寸靠近。
lines.en: I press along the wall, inching closer.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音替我引路。
lines.en: The sound of your breathing guides me.

lines.zh: 门把手在你身后转了一下。
lines.en: The doorknob turned behind you.

lines.zh: 我在数你的脚步，一格一格。
lines.en: I count your steps, tile by tile.

lines.zh: 你往左，左边就没了。
lines.en: Go left, and the left is gone.

lines.zh: 屋里的钟又响了一次。
lines.en: The clock in the room struck again.

lines.zh: 墙后面有人在走，是我。
lines.en: Someone walks behind the wall — that is me.

lines.zh: 空气开始有金属味。
lines.en: The air is beginning to taste of metal.

lines.zh: 你退到的每个角落都变小了。
lines.en: Every corner you retreat to has grown smaller.

lines.zh: 我不着急，走廊很长。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the corridor is long.

lines.zh: 你的影子被拉到了我这边。
lines.en: Your shadow has been pulled over to my side.

lines.zh: 我听见你把门锁上了。
lines.en: I heard you lock the door.

lines.zh: 锁是好东西，对我没用。
lines.en: Locks are useful things. They do not work on me.

lines.zh: 我把出口挪到了别处。
lines.en: I have moved the exit somewhere else.

lines.zh: 你踩的那块地板是空的。
lines.en: The floorboard you stepped on is hollow.

lines.zh: 我停下来了，你也停下来了。
lines.en: I stopped, and so did you.

lines.zh: 低音还在升高。
lines.en: The low tone is still rising.

lines.zh: 再过一会儿，你会听见敲门。
lines.en: In a moment you will hear knocking.

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩三步。
lines.en: Only three steps remain between us.

lines.zh: 敲门声响了三下，是我。
lines.en: Three knocks. That is me.

lines.zh: 你脚下的地板张开了。
lines.en: The floor opens beneath you.

lines.zh: 房间的四壁一起往里挤。
lines.en: All four walls press inward.

lines.zh: 你的耳朵里开始嗡鸣。
lines.en: A ringing begins in your ears.

lines.zh: 墙纸翻卷，把走廊折成另一间屋。
lines.en: The wallpaper peels and folds the hall into another room.

lines.zh: 门在你眼前变成墙。
lines.en: The door turns into wall before your eyes.

lines.zh: 你摸到的东西都不是实的。
lines.en: Nothing you touch is solid.

lines.zh: 低音一沉，你脚下就没有地板。
lines.en: The bass drops and there is no floor under you.

lines.zh: 走廊弯成了一个圈。
lines.en: The corridor bends into a circle.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕了。
lines.en: I have hold of your wrist.

lines.zh: 你嘴里尝到金属味。
lines.en: You taste metal in your mouth.

lines.zh: 墙缝里透出一点光，然后灭了。
lines.en: A little light seeps through a crack, then dies.

lines.zh: 你在原地，可地点变了。
lines.en: You have not moved, yet the place has changed.

lines.zh: 我推了你一下，很轻。
lines.en: I gave you a push. It was gentle.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到不该有的台阶。
lines.en: Your knee strikes a step that should not be there.

lines.zh: 这里已经不在刚才的世界了。
lines.en: This is no longer the world you were in.

lines.zh: 先响三下，门并没有。
lines.en: Three knocks first — and there is no door.

lines.zh: 低音从地板下面升起来。
lines.en: A low tone rises from under the floor.

lines.zh: 屋子里的光退到墙角。
lines.en: The light in the room retreats into the corners.

lines.zh: 我在你最近的空处站定。
lines.en: I take my place at the nearest empty spot.

lines.zh: 墙纸开始一块块卷起。
lines.en: The wallpaper curls away in strips.

lines.zh: 你听见的那个声音，是我来了。
lines.en: That sound you heard was my arrival.

lines.zh: 天花板低了下来。
lines.en: The ceiling has come down lower.

lines.zh: 地上的灰尘朝一个方向聚。
lines.en: Dust on the floor gathers in one direction.

lines.zh: 我出现时，温度降了。
lines.en: The temperature dropped when I appeared.

lines.zh: 门从里面自己扣上了。
lines.en: The door latched itself from within.

lines.zh: 三声敲门之后，低音从地下起来。
lines.en: After three knocks, the bass rises from below.

lines.zh: 我不用推门，我就在门后。
lines.en: I need not open doors; I am behind them.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的角数变多了。
lines.en: This room has more corners than before.

lines.zh: 低音停了，剩下的就是脚步。
lines.en: The low tone stopped; only footsteps remain.

lines.zh: 我站在光与光的缝隙里。
lines.en: I stand in the gap between two lights.

lines.zh: 空气压下来，像一层毯子。
lines.en: The air presses down like a blanket.

lines.zh: 我先把门关上，再打招呼。
lines.en: I shut the door first, then say hello.

lines.zh: 窗外什么也没有了。
lines.en: There is nothing outside the window now.

lines.zh: 墙里传来一声闷响。
lines.en: A muffled thud comes from inside the wall.

lines.zh: 我从最近的角落走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the nearest corner.

lines.zh: 火光照到我，我不喜欢被看清。
lines.en: Firelight finds me, and I dislike being seen.

lines.zh: 你从高处落下，我在下面接着。
lines.en: You fell from above. I was there below to catch you.

lines.zh: 水把这个房间填满了。
lines.en: Water has filled this room.

lines.zh: 爆炸把墙推倒，可我还是在。
lines.en: The blast knocked down walls, and I am still here.

lines.zh: 那东西穿过我，扎进了门板。
lines.en: It passed through me and stuck in the door.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我退了一步。
lines.en: That force made me take one step back.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，很久。
lines.en: I have been hungry a very long time.

lines.zh: 雷光把走廊照白，我暂时不见了。
lines.en: Lightning whited out the corridor, and I vanished for a moment.

lines.zh: 虚空和我很像，可它不听话。
lines.en: The void is much like me, but it does not obey.
